title: How to Generate an MCP App Submission Pack for ChatGPT
summary: Use Manufact to generate an MCP App submission pack for ChatGPT with listing copy, reviewer test cases, screenshots, and a demo video.
body_markdown:
To generate an MCP App submission pack for ChatGPT, connect your MCP app to Manufact, open **Publish → Submission pack** , and click **Generate pack** . Manufact reads the live server and generates listing copy, tool justifications, and reviewer test cases. It can also generate the screenshots and demo video. You get the materials for the directory in one place, then review them before submitting.


You can[generate a pack in Manufact](https://manufact.com/platform/submission-pack) for a server hosted on Manufact or connected by URL. For the directory form itself, use the existing[field-by-field submission guide](https://manufact.com/blog/publish-mcp-app-on-chatgpt) and check[OpenAI's current requirements](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001040-submitting-apps-to-the-chatgpt-app-directory) .


## Check the live app before generating


Start with the deployed MCP endpoint that reviewers will reach. In Manufact Cloud, open the server and run its[publish checks](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/publish-checks) . Resolve failures in protocol behavior, tool metadata, security, or app resources by copying the fix prompt. Ensure resolution before writing listing copy around them. The[PredictLeads story](https://manufact.com/blog/predictleads-mcp-marketplace-review) shows why finding schema and response issues before review matters.


Next, run the app's core task in the clients you support. Manufact's[test suites](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/testing) can check expected tool calls and outcomes across clients. The generated materials should describe a flow reviewers can actually complete.


If the server uses OAuth, verify the dashboard has a suitable test connection. Manufact uses that connection for inspection, test suites, and authenticated publish checks. Its[dashboard OAuth guide](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/dashboard-oauth) recommends a dedicated account with representative sample data and limited permissions.


## Click Generate pack in Manufact


Open your server in the Manufact dashboard. Go to **Publish → Submission pack** and click **Generate pack** . You do not need to write the listing or assemble reviewer cases from scratch. Manufact drafts them from the tools and capabilities exposed by your live server. The feature works for Manufact-hosted and URL-connected servers. It requires the Hobby plan or above and is billed per generation; see the[current pricing and steps](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/submission-pack) .


Click Generate pack to create the submission materials from your MCP app.


The generated pack includes:


Asset What Manufact generates


Directory listing copy A name, descriptions, and category based on the server.


Tool justifications Draft explanations of why each tool needs the access it requests.


Reviewer test cases Prompts and expected outcomes that show reviewers how to exercise the app.


Review the output for accuracy, adjust the wording to match your product, and paste the finished copy into the directory form. If the draft describes an outdated tool, update the server and regenerate the pack so the materials match what reviewers will see.


## Generate screenshots and a demo video in the same pack


Use Manufact's **Submission pack** to generate the screenshots and demo video too. You can select up to four tools for screenshots, or let Manufact choose representative tools. Add a custom instruction if you want the visuals to show a specific journey, such as a search, booking, or checkout flow. Manufact generates the assets from the app; screenshot progress appears in the dashboard as each result is ready.


Open the generated images and video. If they show the wrong tool or miss the app's useful state, change the tool selection or custom instructions and generate them again in Manufact. Check the final assets against the destination directory's current requirements before uploading them. The[Submission pack docs](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/submission-pack) show the available controls for screenshots and video.


## Do a final reviewer pass


Give the materials to a teammate who has not built the app. Ask them to follow a test case using only the supplied instructions and test account. Watch for missing setup steps, permissions the account lacks, or an expected result that is too vague to verify.


Then compare the generated listing, tool justifications, screenshots, and video with the live app one more time. Make sure privacy and terms links resolve, the described actions match the current tools, and the demo follows a path a reviewer can reproduce. The[ChatGPT form walkthrough](https://manufact.com/blog/publish-mcp-app-on-chatgpt) covers the remaining submission fields and blockers.

## FAQ


### Do I need to host the MCP server on Manufact to generate a pack?


No. The[Submission pack documentation](https://docs.manufact.com/dashboard/submission-pack) says it works for Manufact-hosted servers and external servers connected by URL.


### Does generating a pack submit the app to ChatGPT?


No. Manufact automatically generates the submission materials. You review them, then complete the directory form and follow its current requirements.


### Should I generate the pack before running publish checks?


Run publish checks and client tests first. Fixing the live server after generating assets can leave the listing, test cases, and screenshots describing an older version.


When your server passes its checks and the core journey works in the target client,[generate the whole pack in Manufact](https://manufact.com/platform/submission-pack) . Review the copy, screenshots, video, and test cases, then submit them through the directory form.
